verdict.rationale: Eqvista's own cap-table page states it "supports ASC 718 reporting" alongside Rule 701 and Form 3921, so the capability is first-party. However, that single marketing line is the only evidence: nothing shows what the report contains, how it is produced, or whether it is auditor-ready. Missing for 10: documentation of ASC 718 expense calculation and amortization schedules, report export formats suitable for accountants and auditors, plan or tier availability, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
